flagged.comment: Multiple concurrent departmental reviews remain incomplete and pending: Fire (F1, F4 pending); Water Quality (WQ1-3, WQ9, WQ11, WQ13-14 pending); Drainage Engineering (DE3-4, DE6-14 pending); Transportation (TPW2, TPW18 pending); Austin Water Utility Development (AW1-2 pending); City Arborist (CA1-CA6 pending); Case Manager approval blocks (CM8, CM10, CM11 not cleared). Plan cannot be approved or released until all departmental reviews are completed.

Concurrent departmental reviews have not been completed before final plan approval and release. Multiple departmental comments remain PENDING as of Update U1: Fire Department (F1 standard notes, F4 SER documentation), Austin Water (AW1 Service Extension Request, AW2 Pipeline Engineering approval), Environmental (EV16-18 inspection fees and ESC fiscal), Water Quality (WQ1, WQ3, WQ9, WQ11, WQ13-14), Drainage Engineering (DE3, DE4, DE6, DE8-13), and Transportation (TPW2). Site plan approval stamp is blank; plan is not yet approved.

Multiple departmental reviews have pending unresolved items: Drainage Engineering (9 pending items including easement documentation, basin setback, maintenance ramp waivers, channel profiles and cross-sections); Fire Department (2 pending items for standard notes and SER documentation); Water Quality (6 pending items for water quality design, impervious cover treatment, landscape plans, and basin ratios); Austin Water (2 pending items including required Service Extension Request); Transportation (1 pending item); and PARD (1 pending item). Approval stamps on cover sheet remain blank with no departmental signatures obtained. Site plan has not been released for general compliance and remains in comment response phase.

Fire Department approval has not been completed. Two critical Fire Department comments remain pending: F1 (general Fire Department notes required on general notes sheet) and F4 (fire flow confirmation pending Service Extension Request documentation for wastewater service showing available 1,471 GPM is insufficient for reduced demand of 1,500 GPM). Approval must be obtained prior to site plan release.

Fire Department approval has not been completed. Two comments remain PENDING: (F1) Standard Fire Department Notes required on general notes sheet per AFD Fire Criteria Manual section 4.1.0; (F4) Fire hydrant flow test shows 1,471 gpm available at 20 psi, which is unable to support the reduced fire flow demand of 1,500 gpm shown on cover sheet. Service Extension Request documentation from Austin Water is required to confirm whether AWU is requiring an SER for this property per IFC Appendix B.

Fire Department approval has not been obtained and documented. Comment F1 (status: PENDING) requires standard Fire Department notes on the general notes sheet. Comment F4 (status: PENDING) requires documentation of Service Extension Request (SER) approval for fire hydrant flow test, as the measured available fire flow of 1,471 GPM at 20 psi is insufficient to support the reduced fire flow demand of 1,500 GPM shown on the cover sheet. AFD approval has not been signed off.

The parkland dedication fee amount ($177,244.24) has been calculated for 39 units but must be verified and fee payment processed prior to certificate of occupancy, not site plan approval; however, the departmental review sign-off is required before site plan approval.
